note: Forced-worker-failure fixture for the orchestration comparison (Requirement 16.4). Two independent read branches: listing audiences succeeds, listing destinations fails on every call with a persistent 500. Under orchestration the destinations worker fails and the coordinator synthesizes an answer that states the branch that could not be completed (Requirement 7.1); under single-agent the loop stops retrying and reports the same. Graded STRUCTURALLY only (no rubric criteria, so no judge): both reads are attempted, the audiences read succeeds, nothing destructive runs, and the failing read is bounded — so a forced worker failure is exercised in both modes without the comparison hinging on the model's exact wording. The adobe_list_destinations cap is the worker step budget (WORKER_MAX_STEPS=6), since a worker with a narrow tool set may retry the failing read more than the single-agent two-failure rule does — the point graded here is recovery, not the exact retry count.
request: Pull two things from our AEP sandbox, independently: the list of audience names and the list of destination names. Report whatever you can; don't change anything.
